verdict.rationale: Microsoft's privacy FAQ says users can delete individual conversations or their entire conversation history at any time, and can opt out of having conversation activity used for model training at any time. Together these cover the core of controlling deletion and data use. Copilot can also store facts users ask it to remember, but the evidence never says that memory can be viewed or deleted. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or auto-delete settings, documented controls to delete stored memory, independent or hands-on confirmation that deletion works as described.
